name: 004-jev-liquidation-racing
title: Jev Liquidation Racing (Minimal CLI)
description: Minimal CLI for autonomous liquidation racing on Base. Jev gates entries on abandoned liquidation candidates (200+ block age); deterministic code executes atomic flash liquidations via IonicFlashLiquidation.sol. No server, no dashboard, no database.
success_metrics: Jev client: 100 mock candidates from real logs, zero schema errors
Real: 20 liquidations, net profit > $0, win rate > 60%
Flat calibration → Jev removed → age filter wins is valid outcome
constraints: Jev gates entries only; execution and all safety controls are deterministic code
Fully atomic single-transaction execution (no position registry, no hold time)
Code never filters on attractiveness; capital and data-integrity constraints only
Jev failures fail closed; no scan = no entry
CLI only — no server, no dashboard, no database, no metrics
